WELCOME_MODAL.TAGLINE: A fast, Git-friendly, and open-source API client.
WELCOME_MODAL.STORAGE_TITLE: Where should we store your collections?
WELCOME_MODAL.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION: Marrone saves collections as plain files on your filesystem, perfect for version control with Git.
WELCOME_MODAL.STORAGE_HINT: Each collection and workspace gets its own folder inside this directory. You can change this later.
WELCOME_MODAL.APPEARANCE_DESCRIPTION: Pick a look that feels right. You can always change this later in Preferences.
WELCOME_MODAL.GETSTARTED_DESCRIPTION: Create a new collection to start building requests, or import one you already have.
WELCOME_MODAL.CREATE_COLLECTION_DESC: Start fresh with a new API collection
WELCOME_MODAL.IMPORT_COLLECTION_DESC: Bring in Postman, OpenAPI/Swagger, or Insomnia
WELCOME_MODAL.OPEN_COLLECTION_DESC: Open a Marrone collection from your filesystem
WELCOME_MODAL.START_REQUEST_DESC: Jump right in with a new HTTP request
WELCOME_MODAL.HIGHLIGHT_FILESYSTEM_DESC: Collections are plain files on your disk. No cloud sync, no proprietary lock-in.
WELCOME_MODAL.HIGHLIGHT_GIT_DESC: Every request is a readable file. Commit, branch, review, and collaborate using the tools you already know.
WELCOME_MODAL.HIGHLIGHT_PRIVACY_DESC: No account, no login. Marrone works entirely offline, your API keys never leave your machine.
WELCOME_MODAL.HIGHLIGHT_FAST_DESC: Built to be snappy. No bloated runtimes, just a fast, focused tool for exploring and testing APIs.

SECURITY.TITLE: Security
SECURITY.REPORTS_DESC: Control how credentials are exposed in generated reports
SECURITY.INCLUDE_CREDENTIALS: Include credentials (Authorization, Cookie, API Key) in CURL commands within reports

CACHE.TITLE: Cache
CACHE.FILE_CACHE_DESC: Loads your workspace faster by caching opened collections. Marrone refreshes the cache when your collection changes. Clearing it won't affect your original files.
CACHE.SSL_CACHE_DESC: Reuses TLS sessions and connections across requests for faster handshakes. Disable to create a fresh connection for every request.

BETA.TITLE: Beta Features
BETA.DESCRIPTION: Beta features are experimental previews that may change before full release. Try them and share feedback.
BETA.NO_FEATURES: No beta features are currently available
BETA.AI_ASSISTANT_DESC: Generate scripts, tests, and documentation directly from the request tab. Includes contextual chat, scripting autocomplete, and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenAI-compatible providers using your own API key.
BETA.FILE_CACHE_DESC: Speeds up how quickly your collections open by keeping a local cache on disk. Turn it on or clear it anytime from the Cache settings.
BETA.AKAMAI_EDGEGRID_DESC: Sign requests with the Akamai EdgeGrid authentication scheme. Select it from the Auth type dropdown on any request, folder, or collection.
BETA.MOCK_SERVER_DESC: Run a local mock server using response examples defined in your collection. Serve mock API responses for frontend development without a real backend.
BETA.GRPC_SCRIPTING_DESC: Write scripts for gRPC requests. Inspect messages, metadata, and status across the call lifecycle.

AI.SECURITY_NOTICE: Sensitive data is automatically redacted before context is sent to AI providers. Turn off protections if needed, or add custom headers and variables to redact.
AI.REDACT_HEADERS_SUB: Masks Authorization, cookies, API keys and other credential-bearing headers in the request context.
AI.REDACT_BODY_SUB_POST: in JSON and GraphQL variables. Structure and non-sensitive fields still pass through.
AI.REDACT_RESPONSE_SUB_PRE: Sends the response as a shape only — real values replaced with type placeholders (
AI.REDACT_RESPONSE_SUB_POST: ). Turn off to send the actual response body.
AI.REDACT_VARIABLES_SUB_PRE: Masks values whose names look like secrets. Variables explicitly marked
AI.REDACT_VARIABLES_SUB_POST: are always redacted regardless of this switch.
AI.CUSTOM_HEADERS_SUB: Exact, case-insensitive header names to always mask on top of the built-in list.
AI.CUSTOM_VARIABLES_SUB_PRE: Variable names whose values should always be masked when Marrone lists them for the model — for anything you want redacted besides values already flagged as
